{{Quote|Keep your heads down or that E-Web will take them off!|Reyé Hollis, during the Battle of Hoth|<ref name="NEGWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>}}
'''Reyé Hollis''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] of the [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A [[Naboo (people)/Legends|native]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and the son of a [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] [[Lutin Hollis/Legends|veteran]], Hollis fought with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], where he distinguished himself by rescuing and covering the evacuation of many of his fellow Rebel [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] before being wounded. For his acts of selfless valor, Hollis was awarded the [[Kenobi Medallion]] and a promotion.

==Biography==
{{Quote|We have spotted Imperial walkers!|Reyé Hollis|<ref name="TCG">{{TCG|set=The Empire Strikes Back|cardname=Rebel Hoth Army|link=https://swtcg.com/Content/Images/Cards/ESB/Rebel_Hoth_Army.webp?v=2}}</ref>}}
Reyé Hollis was born and raised on<ref name="Who's Who" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]],<ref name="Who's Who" /> the son<ref name="CSWE-Hollis" /> of [[Lutin Hollis/Legends|Lutin Hollis]], who served with the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] before and during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Following in his [[Parent/Legends|father's]] footsteps, Hollis fought with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the subsequent [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], eventually being assigned to the [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] headquarters of [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on the [[Water/Legends|ice]] planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]<ref name="Who's Who" /> by [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].</ref> At some point during his career with the Rebel Alliance, Hollis earned the [[Kalidor Crescent/Legends|Kalidor Crescent]], a prestigious award.<ref name="Who's Who" />

While on Hoth, Hollis served with Echo Base's complement of [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Special Forces]] [[Troop/Legends|troops]] under the command of [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Ledick Firest/Legends|Ledick Firest]], as one of Firest's top [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeants]].<ref name="Who's Who" /> When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] discovered the existence of Echo Base<ref name="ESB" /> in 3 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]],<ref name="NEC" /> Hollis helped prepare the base's perimeter defenses in the face of the imminent Imperial invasion.<ref name="ESB" />

Hollis fought in the Rebels' icy trenches during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], warning his men to stay low to avoid being shot down by the Imperials' [[E-Web heavy repeating blaster/Legends|E-Web heavy repeating blasters]].<ref name="NEGWT" /> He distinguished himself during the battle by rescuing a cut-off [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of Rebel [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], pulling two of his medical personnel out of the way of an advancing [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transport]], and finally being wounded while manning a [[DF.9/Legends|DF.9]] anti-[[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] battery to cover the retreat of his [[Company/Legends|company]].<ref name="Who's Who" />

Hollis was the only sergeant in Firest's five companies to survive the staggering Rebel defeat at the Battle of Hoth. He received the [[Kenobi Medallion]], a bronze device for his previously earned Kalidor Crescent, and a promotion for his acts of heroism during the battle.<ref name="Who's Who" />

==Personality and traits==
Hollis' Kenobi Medallion, earned during the Battle of Hoth, demonstrated his acts of selfless valor in helping to rescue several Echo Base soldiers, including his fleeing company, at the expense of his own safety. A [[Human/Legends|Human]] male,<ref name="Who's Who" /> Hollis had light skin.<ref name="ESB" />

==Equipment==
Hollis wore the Rebel Echo Base field troops' standard [[Alliance Cold Weather armor|cold-weather armor]] during the Battle of Hoth, including [[Alliance Cold Weather Headgear|headgear]], [[Anti-glare goggles/Legends|anti-glare goggles]], [[Scarf/Legends|scarf]], [[Alliance Cold Weather armor|padded vest]], [[thermal flak jacket]], [[Glove/Legends|gloves]], and [[Alliance Cold Weather Backpack/Legends|backpack]]. He also carried [[Binoculars/Legends|binoculars]].<ref name="ESB" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Notable appearances===
The character of Reyé Hollis first appeared in the [[1980]] film [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']] as an unnamed extra in a brief scene during the opening stages of the Battle of Hoth.<ref name="Who's Who" /> He was first provided a last name, "Hollis," on the [http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/SpecialEdition-Light/large/sergeanthollis.gif "Sergeant Hollis" card] as part of the [[November]] [[1998]] ''[[Special Edition Limited]]'' expansion set of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]].<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Sergeant Hollis}}</ref> The [[February]] [[2004]] article "[[Who's Who in Echo Base: The Unsung Rebels of the Battle of Hoth|Who's Who in Echo Base]]", appearing in [[Star Wars Insider 74|''Star Wars Insider'' 74]], first identified the character's full name, "Reyé Hollis," and expanded upon his acts of valor during the Battle of Hoth that earned him the Kenobi Medallion,<ref name="Who's Who" /> information first established by the ''Star Wars Customizable Card Game''.<ref name="CCG" />

Hollis' first name, in accordance with his [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] origins, has the same ''-é'' suffix as other Naboo ''[[Star Wars]]'' characters, such as [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], [[Sabé/Legends|Sabé]], and [[Ric Olié/Legends|Ric Olié]].<ref name="Complete Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> The "Who's Who in Echo Base" article also identified Hollis as being the son of Lutin Hollis,<ref name="Who's Who" /> a character who first appeared in the [[2000]] [[Wikipedia:Nintendo 64|Nintendo 64]] [[Star Wars video games|game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]''.<ref name="Battle for Naboo">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]''</ref>

===Character confusion and inconsistencies===
[[File:CallumHollis.jpg|thumb|right|250px|''The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia'' identifies the foreground Rebel soldier as both Reyé Hollis and Trey Callum.]]
The November [[2003]] [[The Empire Strikes Back (TCG)|''The Empire Strikes Back'']] expansion set of the ''[[Star Wars Trading Card Game]]'' includes a "Sergeant Hollis" quote on the set's [http://wizards.com/swtcg/images/esb/rebel_hoth_army.jpg "Rebel Hoth Army" card].<ref name="TCG" /> The quote, "We have spotted Imperial walkers!", is identical to the line spoken by the character [[Trey Callum/Legends|Trey Callum]] in the film, and, as such, Hollis should not be confused with Callum.<ref name="ESB" />

In addition, ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', released in [[2008]], uses the same production photo of a Hoth Rebel soldier from ''The Empire Strikes Back'' to illustrate both Hollis and Callum under each character's respective encyclopedic entry.<ref name="CSWE-Callum">{{CSWECite|I|105|Callum, Trey}}</ref><ref name="CSWE-Hollis">{{CSWECite|II|50|Hollis, Sergeant Reyé}}</ref> Given that the actor pictured in the production photo does not definitively visually correspond to either character in the film, this article avoids making a judgment as to which character the production photo's actor is intended to be.

"Who's Who in Echo Base" identifies Hollis, as well as Echo Base [[Controller/Legends|controller]] [[Toryn Farr/Legends|Toryn Farr]], as being recipients of the Kalidor Crescent,<ref name="Who's Who" /> a medal that first appeared in the [[1993]] [[Wikipedia:Personal computer|PC]] game [[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']]. However, the medal is intended to be an award for [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] who perform beyond the call of duty in combat,<ref name="X-Wing">[[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']]</ref> which seems outside the scope of Hollis' and Farr's [[canon]]ically-established service.<ref name="Who's Who" />
